_about: What Word 16.106 for Mac does with a table grid's odd values, for crates/ooxml-oracle/word/probes/grid_values_probe.py (documents in cases/grid_values_cases.py: three 2000-twip grid columns, fixed layout; the case's row, then R1 R2 R3). 'table': the case's table as written; 'opened': whether Word opened and saved it; 'saved': the rows as Word wrote them again (gridBefore/gridAfter/gridSpan/vMerge values, text, the wrappers a cell sits in) and the tblGrid widths; 'drawn': per marker in Word's PDF the grid column its text starts in (R1's left is 0, 100 pt a column) and whether it is on R1's line. Regenerate with python crates/ooxml-oracle/word/probes/grid_values_probe.py.
